name: roman chair sit-up
description: A sit-up on a Roman-chair or decline bench with the feet anchored, working the abs through a controlled trunk curl.
instructions: Adjust the bench so your hips are supported and your feet are secured beneath the pads.
Cross your arms over your chest and lean back under control.
Curl your trunk up without jerking or pulling on your neck.
Lower slowly to the starting angle and repeat.
